title: feat(scanner): add multicall/batched scanning engine
body:
This branch adds a first-cut scanning engine to the core package and a simple Scan UI in the web app.

Features:
- scanMnemonic API: derive addresses across derivation paths and index ranges, batch ETH balance checks, return discovered non-zero addresses
- multicall placeholder for future ERC-20 batch queries
- simple web Scan UI to configure and run scans

Notes:
- This implementation uses provider.getBalance in batches. We will iterate to add true Multicall usage and ERC-20 detection next.
- Scanning large ranges on mainnet with public RPC endpoints may be slow. Add RPC API keys in .env for better throughput.
head: feat/scanner
